note: Pilot of the tail brief. METHOD: one background script queried, for all 100 composers, MusicBrainz (artist search, then work?artist=<mbid>&inc=recording-rels: every work with its linked recordings in one call) and the Apple Music catalogue (iTunes Search API, no key); hits were then checked with iTunes Lookup track lists (timings give durations) and IMSLP work info via api.php. About 55 tool calls, 1 WebSearch. WHERE THE BRIEF FAILED OR WAS UNCLEAR: (1) Presto's search page returns a Cloudflare challenge to curl and Naxos Music Library needs a login, so the two named catalogues were unusable; Apple Music (itunes.apple.com/search and /lookup) worked well and should be added to 'Sources' (it is a commercial catalogue and gives track timings). (2) The MusicBrainz query in the brief (work?query=artist:"Surname, Given") is weaker than artist search + work browse with inc=recording-rels; MusicBrainz misses most small-label discs found on Apple Music. (3) 'Check each composer once for any commercial recording of their chamber music': unclear whether recordings of non-chamber works, or of chamber works that are not candidates, count as 'something turned up'. I treated concertos, symphonies, operas and songs as 'none found' (triage reason), and for composers with other chamber recordings I skipped the pages one by one as 'not performed or recorded'. (4) Whether tail slices may add works not on IMSLP is not said; I added 11 found on discs I opened (Cardon Op. 9 harp trios, Catel's three manuscript clarinet quartets, six Del Cinque sonatas for three cellos). Recorded but not added (details unchecked): Cannabich Flute Quintets Op. 7 Nos. 3–6 (CPO), Elsner Septet in D and String Quartets Op. 1, Du Puy Bassoon Quintet in A minor (Gringolts Quartet), Kellie's Kilravock quartets and trio sonatas (Concerto Caledonia). (5) A page holding several works of which only some are recorded: I wrote a second skipped line for the same page with works = the unrecorded count (Delange, Dauprat); the brief should say so. (6) 'year' has no rule for undated prints; I used 'c. 1775', 'c. 1789' and left n.d. prints blank. OPEN PROBLEMS: possible recordings not matched to these pages: Družecký Oboe Quartet in D (CPO 2023 has one in D), Cannabich Oboe Quartet in B-flat (1999 album, composer of the track unclear), Ferrandini String Quartet in G minor (Scholl/Echo du Danube 'Quartet in G minor'), Call Variations Op. 68 (Guitart 2023), Dauprat Op. 6 No. 2 (MusicBrainz numbering conflicts with No. 3). Keys of Cirri Opp. 9 and 13 come from the recordings; Il Fuggilotio may play Op. 9 Nos. 1–4 on flutes; Cirri Op. 13 and Dauprat Op. 6 No. 1 rest on self-released discs. Name searches for common names (Carter, Cooper, Dale, Edwards, Dolphin, Festoni, Fleury) are swamped by namesakes, so 'none found' is weaker there. Eight living or recent self-uploading composers sit in this 'classical' slice (census era looks wrong for them); proposed in exclude_composers on the MusicBrainz/Apple Music check only. Census: outOfScope 'Demachi 6 Sonatas for 3 Flutes, Op.17' is labelled 'violins alone' (probably 'no string part'; not checked); the census gives Classical harpsichord trios formation 'other' (Eichner Op. 2) although the brief maps Classical keyboard to piano. Levels are estimates; no work here was graded above 6.
